name: Bandenitz (Germany)
description: Vertically divided red and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bandenitz (a black dragon on yellow, a red bird on white and an eagle's leg on red).
history: Arms and flag were designed by the Schwerin heraldist Karl-Heinz Steinbruch; the arms were approved on 26 August 1998 and the flag on 7 September 2009 by the Ministry of the Interior.

features.role: Bandenitz arms — dragon, bird and eagle's leg
